home.hero.subtitle: Stream telemetry, model assets, automate flows, and ship dashboards — all from one extensible Rust runtime. Built for energy, water and HVAC at scale.
home.feature.flows.title: Visual runtime
home.feature.flows.body: Visual flows compile to a deterministic Rust runtime. Hot-reload in dev, zero-downtime in prod.
home.feature.extensions.title: Module-Federation
home.feature.extensions.body: Drop-in extensions contribute pages, widgets, and commands without forks. Singletons negotiated automatically.
home.feature.sdui.title: Server-driven UI
home.feature.sdui.body: Design once, render on web, mobile, and panel. No native rebuild required.
home.feature.warehouse.title: Warehouse history
home.feature.warehouse.body: Sub-second queries across millions of points and tags. Tags are Bool|Str — L1 to L3 marts on demand.
home.feature.authz.title: Per-user gating
home.feature.authz.body: Dynamic resources, not static routes. Gate any SDUI page per user, per tenant, per role.
home.feature.git.title: Everything is a file
home.feature.git.body: Tags, flows, dashboards — all in git. Branch, diff, review, revert.
home.cta2.subtitle: Install the agent, point at your devices, and ship your first dashboard before lunch.
